current.text: He is expected to start for Boston ahead of Payton Pritchard. The newest projected starting five is Derrick White, Scheierman, Jayson Tatum, Paul George and Neemias Queta.
The starting call is not firm. One expert is only about 45% sure he starts and expects only about 20 to 22 minutes a night.
Boston is very deep, with at least 12 rotation-level players, so minutes are spread thin.
In his last 8 games as a starter last season he played 23 minutes a night and averaged 10 points, 2.5 threes, 3 rebounds and 2.5 assists. He shot 47% from the field and did not miss a free throw.
Experts see him as a late flier or swing pick for deeper leagues and a name to watch in his third year. One expert has him barely inside the top 300.
He could reach double-digit scoring if he gets more catch-and-shoot looks.

durable.text: He can shoot and pass, is not a terrible defender and has more size than Pritchard.

note: Yahoo ranks him 296 and ESPN 213, and both sites give him a value of 0 USD. In a league where only 144 players are drafted, he should go undrafted. His projected line has no real category strength, though he adds threes, a good FT% on low volume and few turnovers. Check early whether he keeps the starting job and plays 23 or more minutes, as he did in his late-season starter stretch (10 points, 2.5 threes). If he does, he is a cheap waiver add.
